pp.ready.text: Hi! I'm Puff! Will you help me line up my parade?

pp.back.text: Welcome back! The parade is waiting for you!

pp.story.1.text: Today is Puff's big parade on Monster Island!

pp.story.2.text: Puff lined everyone up in a pattern. Duck, frog, duck, frog!

pp.story.3.text: Then a big wind blew, and the marchers tumbled out of line!

pp.story.4.text: Help Puff fill every gap, so the parade can march!

pp.story.mid1.text: The parade starts to march. Boom, ding, boom, ding!

pp.story.mid2.text: Halfway down the street! Everyone is cheering.

pp.story.mid3.text: The big stage is close. Keep the pattern going!

pp.story.end1.text: The parade marched all the way to the big stage!

pp.story.end2.text: You found the part that repeats, and kept the pattern going.

pp.story.end3.text: Puff made you a Parade Star sticker!

pp.prompt.tutorial.text: Star, heart, star, heart, star. What comes next? Put it in the gap!

pp.prompt.next.text: What comes next in the parade?

pp.prompt.missing.text: Who is missing from the parade?

pp.prompt.grow.text: The towers grow! What comes next?

pp.prompt.grow2.text: The towers grow! What are the next two?

pp.help.explain.text: Say the parade out loud from the start. Listen for what comes again!

pp.help.hint.text: I put a box around each part. Look at the boxes, then try again!

pp.retry.text: Hmm, look at the parade again from the start.

pp.hint.model.text: Let's march along together. Say each one with me!

pp.hint.modelTap.text: Now put the glowing marchers in the gaps.

pp.idle.text: Drag a marcher into the gap, or just tap one!

pp.check.text: All the gaps are full. Tap the check to march!

pp.praise.1.text: You found what repeats and kept the parade going!

pp.praise.2.text: You looked from the start and spotted the pattern!

pp.praise.3.text: You checked every part of the pattern. Hooray!

pp.praise.4.text: The parade marches on. You noticed what comes next!
